  Good afternoon,
  Subject: Right-of-access request dated 17 July 2026 - overdue status and escalation
 On 17 July 2026, I made a Subject Access Request through my Universal Credit journal and asked for that

 DWP Right of Access or data-protection team.

  confirm in writing:
  the date on which DWP recorded receipt of my request;
  the responsible team and reference number;
  whether any identification or clarification is required from me;
  whether DWP considers the response period to have been paused or extended, and, if so, the legal basis,

  the current status of the request and the date by which the complete response will be provided; and

  journal request, why I was not promptly told that another route or further information was required, and how
  the request can now be completed without losing the original chronology.
  Please record the response and routing outcome in my journal. This is a data-protection matter rather than a
  work-coach matter.
    If a complete response cannot be provided promptly, please register this as a formal complaint about the
  handling of my right-of-access request and provide the DWP complaint reference, the route to the DWP Data
  Protection Officer, and the information needed to take the matter to the Information Commissioner's Office if it
  remains unresolved.
